_note: Two orthogonal axes: age_band (pure age) + role (occupation/enrolment). A gate is a list of clauses OR'd together (any clause = eligible); each clause is {field:[values]} AND across fields; everyone = no clause. Values must match EXACTLY. work_type applies only to role=working (else n/a); general workplace programmes need a registered employer (employee OR manual-industrial), Total WSH needs manual-industrial, gig-self-employed reaches no workplace programme.
